candidates.summary: the stamped benchmark passes the param with a nil T, so declaredTypeName returns "" at its first type assertion and the run that prices the native never builds the type name
candidates.failure_scenario: Every real call is Of(&T{}): the any param carries T = *PointerType{Elt: *DeclaredType}, so declaredTypeName (reflect.go:127-143) concatenates dt.PkgPath + "." + dt.Name and the wrapper pushes a non-empty r3. The bench sets gno.TypedValue{V: PointerValue{...}} with no T, so t.(*gno.PointerType) fails and "" comes back. The header says the stamped path is measured including 'read the declared type's name' (line 8) and that the harness 'builds the shape the native receives from Gno' (line 28); neither holds, so the 1196ns median behind Base 1200 omits that branch and a change making it expensive leaves the bench unchanged
candidates.verify_by: in a scratch worktree set T: &gno.PointerType{Elt: &gno.DeclaredType{PkgPath: reflectBenchPkgPath, Name: "Token", Base: &gno.StructType{}}} on line 54, then go test ./gnovm/cmd/calibrate -run '^$' -bench 'Reflect_ObjectInfo_Stamped' -count 5 before and after; also plant panic("reached") after the PointerType assertion in declaredTypeName and confirm the unmodified bench stays green
candidates.evidence: reflect_bench_test.go:54 reads `m.Blocks[0].Values[0] = gno.TypedValue{V: gno.PointerValue{TV: &hiv.Value, Base: hiv}}` (no T); reflect.go:133-136 `pt, ok := t.(*gno.PointerType); if !ok { return "" }`
